explanation.event_selection: The specification uses task_move_forward to explore clear space and the two task-level rotation events to redirect exploration around observed obstacles. All four obstacle-sensor observations are included because they determine the applicable coverage action. Low-level movement events are omitted because mission decisions must use task-level events and low-level motion is handled by the fixed collision_avoidance specification.
explanation.transition_design: In clear_path, only task_move_forward is enabled. A front obstacle enables either task-level rotation in front_blocked, while right_blocked enables task_rotate_counterclockwise and left_blocked enables task_rotate_clockwise so the robot turns away from the detected side obstacle. State-changing observation transitions track every change in sensed obstruction, and path_clear restores forward exploration. All states are marked because coverage is an indefinitely repeatable mission with no terminal completion condition.
